title: Journey Rules
text: The journey has 5 legs with 20 events each.
Fights are the dominant journey event.
Rest events cannot appear in the first half of a leg and must respect a 3-event cooldown.
Wander Group advances the leg by 5 events.
Fairy Found can save a life if equipped in the camping/medical slot.
Dungeons are optional and can be exited before combat.
